Job_Title: Insurance Workflow automation for Financial advice SaaS
Skills: API Development, React, Amazon Web Services, Full-Stack Development, Back-End Development
Description: Build an end-to-end insurance workflow automation feature for a multi-tenant financial advice SaaS platform, replacing a manual process where advisers prepared client insurance information and emailed it to multiple insurers. The solution brings the complete outbound workflow into the existing SaaS platform while keeping insurers on the email systems they already use. It combines structured data collection, insurance needs analysis, document generation, transactional email, delivery tracking, and auditability into a single workflow. Key deliverables include: • Client insurance pre-assessment forms with per-person submissions and mandatory adviser review • Automated insurance needs summaries combining calculator data and existing policy information • Branded, white-labelled A4 PDF generation using headless Chromium, including de-identified versions for privacy-sensitive workflows • Multi-tenant insurer configuration with dealer group → practice → adviser settings inheritance and per-send overrides • Email composition with attachments, scanned-file validation, configurable recipients, and exact per-recipient previews • Serverless email dispatch through Amazon SES with one individually addressed email per insurer and idempotent send protection • SES/SNS-based delivery, bounce and complaint tracking with recipient-level status and retry handling • Immutable enquiry snapshots and a complete audit trail of what was sent, to whom, when, and by whom • Consent gates and privacy controls designed around the handling of sensitive insurance and health information The feature is designed for integration into an existing production SaaS codebase rather than as an isolated application, with integration across existing forms, client records, document storage, authentication, email infrastructure, and AWS serverless services. Tech stack: React, Node.js, Material UI, Redux, AWS Amplify, AWS AppSync, GraphQL, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Amazon SES, Amazon SNS, Amazon S3, Amazon Cognito, and Puppeteer/headless Chromium.

Skills: Web Testing, Database Testing, Web Development, JavaScript
Description: We run a custom-built business platform (Next.js/TypeScript + Supabase/Postgres with Row Level Security, Xero integration, Microsoft Graph email) that handles CRM, quoting, proposals, sales orders, invoicing and HR-adjacent data for a small group of related companies sharing one database. We're extending it from one company to several, and want an independent, adversarial audit before that happens. This is a fixed-scope, one-off engagement — not ongoing development. Scope: Authentication, session handling, and our token-gated public link pages Row Level Security policies — confirming one company's data can never be read from another's session (our top priority) Server-side authorization on API routes (no trusting client-supplied IDs) Injection risks (SQL/XSS/SSRF) across public forms and customer-facing pages Secrets handling (no service-role keys or credentials exposed client-side) File upload handling on public forms Financial logic sanity-check (pricing/discount calculations, invoice void/undo flows) Code and architecture quality: consistency, dead code, test coverage on access-control and financial paths, dependency CVEs Deliverables: A findings register — each item with severity, affected files/routes, a working reproduction (PoC), and a suggested fix A one-page executive summary in plain English A retest pass after we apply fixes, confirming each Critical/High is actually closed — included in your quoted price, not billed separately Supporting evidence (screenshots, logs, or scripts) for every Critical/High finding We'll provide a sandboxed/staging copy of the codebase seeded with fake data — no production access, no live customer data, no live financial credentials.
